reportLanguage.description: Language of findings, explanations and the chat. ISO code (en, ru, sr…) or a name.

commentLanguage.description: Language of comments published to the PR.

commentStyle.description: Tone/format instructions for generated PR comments.

rules.description: Glob patterns of rule files (replaces the defaults). Use rulesExtra to add to the defaults.

rulesExtra.description: Glob patterns of rule files added to the defaults, e.g. "docs/conventions/**/*.md".

ignore.description: Glob patterns of files excluded from review (replaces the defaults). Use ignoreExtra to add.

ignoreExtra.description: Glob patterns added to the default ignore list, e.g. "**/*.generated.ts".

reviewers.description: Enable/disable reviewers or change their model, by name.

minSeverity.description: Findings below this severity are dropped.

model.description: "auto" = opus for bugs/security, sonnet for the rest; or haiku | sonnet | opus.

map.description: PR map ("how it works" tab): flows of the changed code as a graph.

mode.description: on-demand = build from a button in the UI; always = build together with the review; off = no map tab.

inbox.description: PRs waiting for your review, across repos (`sieve inbox`, /sieve:inbox). Read from ~/.sieve/settings.json only.

port.description: Fixed port of the inbox page (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/inbox), so it can be bookmarked.

requested.description: me = requested from you personally; me-or-team = also via a team you are in (e.g. CODEOWNERS).

owners.description: Only repos of these users / orgs. Empty = all.

showReviewed.description: Also list open PRs you reviewed before that no longer request you.

checkouts.description: "owner/repo" → path of a local checkout to run reviews from (its rules, gitignored ones included). Repos you reviewed from a checkout are remembered automatically.
